summary: UI/UX Dark Theme Contrast Fixes, Gari Hisab Header Cleanup, and Dashboard Owner Panel Modernization plan. Addresses illegible text caused by silver/light backgrounds in dark mode across Dashcam, Fuel/Weather, and Bilty cards, removes the redundant top header in VehicleAccountView, and elevates the owner panel to the top of the dashboard with 'Create Bilty' and 'View All Bilties' action buttons.
